scripts.screenshots: pnpm build && cargo build -p darkwire --features test-hooks && pnpm --filter @darkwire/e2e exec playwright install chromium && pnpm --filter @darkwire/e2e screenshots
scripts.demo: pnpm build && cargo build --release -p darkwire && node scripts/demo-cast.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm --filter @darkwire/web exec tsx src/tokens/run-gates.ts && pnpm format:check && shellcheck -s sh install.sh && pnpm i18n:check && pnpm protocol:check && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.protocol:check: pnpm --filter @darkwire/protocol exec tsx scripts/emit-schemas.ts && git diff --exit-code -- packages/protocol/schema
